resources.string: Vocal-fold cycles in the selected time
Cycles = frequency × time in seconds. One cycle lasts 1,000 ÷ frequency milliseconds.

Airflow can set the vocal folds vibrating during phonation. The opening curve here is idealized and shown in slow motion. It is not a recording, a sound-pressure waveform, or an estimate of your voice.
Position in the model time window
A top view of both vocal folds and a curve of their opening. The model shows %1$s cycles.
